title: NostalgicMusicPack
description: Ever crave the old music pack back? If so then this is for you because that's all this pack does.
body:
**WHAT IT DOES:**
So basically depending on the frecancy you have set Minecraft requests a song from its own files and this pack provides one of the older ones making those play instead (the volume Alpha and Beta songs) yes the songs have a rarity system so some songs are Rare like back then. And yes some songs will only play in the Menu/Nether/End
